records.subject: Lateran dedication
records.findingEn: Met 31.134.5, mid-15th-century Lombard gradual cutting, tempera ink and gold on parchment, 10.9 x 9.3 cm, depicts Innocent III's dream of Dominic supporting the collapsing Lateran, not Sylvester's dedication. Exclude from strict dedication coverage; no rating assigned.
records.findingFr: La miniature du Met 31.134.5 représente le songe d’Innocent III et saint Dominique soutenant le Latran, non la dédicace par Sylvestre. Ne pas compter comme couverture stricte.
